things.name: mRNA Entry Channel
things.protocol: single-stranded mRNA, threaded codon by codon
things.description: The small subunit's mRNA channel — entry between the head and shoulder at the neck, whose grip keeps the reading frame.

things.name: Aminoacylation Site
things.protocol: cognate amino acid + ATP at one catalytic pocket
things.description: The synthetase's aminoacylation active site: amino acid and ATP co-bind at the same pocket that charges the tRNA. Diffusive access — a pocket, not a channel.

things.name: GTPase-Associated Center
things.protocol: GTP-loaded elongation factors dock; GDP + Pi release
things.description: The factor-binding hub on the large subunit — sarcin-ricin loop and the L7/L12 stalk. GTP arrives and its hydrolysis products leave through the same real docking site.

things.name: Exit Tunnel
things.description: The polypeptide exit tunnel through the large subunit, opening at the exit port where trigger-factor-class chaperones dock to receive the emerging chain.

things.name: Decoding Site
things.description: The decoding center on the small subunit, where each codon is read against the anticodon of an incoming charged tRNA — selection of the right carrier, not catalysis.

things.name: Peptidyl Transferase Center
things.description: The catalytic heart of the large subunit, all rRNA: forges each peptide bond between the growing chain and the newly accommodated amino acid.

things.name: Translocase
things.description: The ratcheting step: GTP-powered translocation advances mRNA and tRNAs by exactly one codon, moving the whole machine forward.

things.name: Aminoacyl-tRNA Synthetase
things.description: The recharging enzyme: matches each spent tRNA with its cognate amino acid and charges it at ATP's expense — the move that closes the carrier cycle.

things.name: tRNA Pool
things.description: The circulating stock of charged tRNAs — the cycle's memory between one elongation step and the next. Starts full at 100 and drains at the elongation rate.

things.name: Nucleus
things.description: The transcript's origin: the compartment that supplies mRNA, opaque here except as the source of the coding stream.

things.name: Chaperone
things.description: The trigger-factor-class chaperone docked at the exit port, receiving each nascent polypeptide as it emerges — where the model's output lands.

things.name: Cytosol
things.description: The surrounding cytosol: reservoir of free amino acids, ATP and GTP, and the sink for hydrolysis products. Internally opaque — it supplies and receives.

relations.name: mRNA transcript
relations.description: Steady-state transcript supply: codons arriving at the entry channel at the elongation rate.

relations.name: mRNA transcript
relations.description: The threaded transcript handed inward from the channel to the decoding site, reading frame intact.

relations.name: charged tRNA
relations.description: Charged tRNAs leaving the pool to be read at the decoding site — the cycle's working leg.

relations.name: deacylated tRNA
relations.description: The spent carrier, stripped of its amino acid, passed on for recharging.

relations.name: recharged tRNA
relations.description: Recharged tRNA returned to the pool — the leg that closes the loop.

relations.name: free amino acid
relations.description: Free amino acids from the cytosol, co-binding at the aminoacylation pocket.

relations.name: ATP
relations.description: ATP co-bound at the same pocket — the energy that pays for charging.

relations.name: free amino acid
relations.description: The pocket's matter handoff: amino acid delivered into the synthetase.

relations.name: ATP
relations.description: The pocket's energy handoff: ATP delivered into the synthetase.

relations.name: GTP
relations.description: GTP-loaded elongation factors docking at the factor-binding hub.

relations.name: GTP
relations.description: GTP delivered inward to power each translocation step.

relations.name: accommodated amino acid
relations.description: The selected, accommodated amino acid passed to the catalytic center.

relations.name: elongated chain
relations.description: The chain, one residue longer, handed forward for ratcheting.

relations.name: polypeptide chain
relations.description: The growing polypeptide advanced into the exit tunnel.

relations.name: nascent polypeptide
relations.description: The emerging nascent chain, N-terminus first, delivered to the waiting chaperone.

relations.name: GDP and inorganic phosphate
relations.description: Hydrolysis products leaving the translocase after each step.

relations.name: GDP and inorganic phosphate
relations.description: GDP and phosphate returned to the cytosol through the same docking site.

milieu.name: Mg2+ and ionic milieu
milieu.description: The coordination shell: Mg2+-phosphate contacts the folded rRNA, including the PTC's catalytic core, cannot hold its structure without. Diffuse by nature — no channel exists, and none is invented.

system_type.domain: molecular biology: mRNA translation with the tRNA charging cycle closed — the same machine the Ribosome model draws, with the boundary widened until the synthetase that recharges spent tRNA falls inside it
